name: H5N1 bird flu
value: US H5N1 death (1 Nov); no human spread
summary: Three Washington state H5N1 cases linked to cattle, one fatal; no human-to-human spread
state: ECDC reported on 3 Nov that two more Yakima County, Washington, residents had H5N1, one of whom died, making three cases there since October, all exposed to infected cattle (ECDC; CNN). Cambodia confirmed its first human case of the year (CIDRAP). ECDC says human-to-human spread remains rare, and none has been confirmed in these cases.
for_you: Follow UKHSA advice: avoid touching sick or dead birds and report them to Defra.

why: H5N1 is the flu strain scientists most fear could become a pandemic; it has spread to mammals and dairy cattle.
drivers: Human cases, mammal-to-mammal spread, mutations, surveillance.
